findings.motion: HB 691, Voter Protection and Reliance Act (listed among sponsors)
findings.note: Ya Liu is on the sponsor list of HB 691. The bill says a vote cast under the election rules in place on election day cannot be thrown out because of a later law, ruling or rule change, and it speeds up election lawsuits filed close to an election. It does not itself set an ID or citizenship rule. Saved as a related election-integrity bill.
subjects: election-rule changes after ballots are cast

findings.note: House roll call #810, third reading of SB 921, a constitutional amendment titled 'Const. Am./Require Photo ID For All Voters.' The roll call lists Liu among the Noes. The vote passed 73-45, sending the amendment to the November 2026 ballot (per Ballotpedia News). The amendment extends the photo ID requirement beyond in-person voting to mail voting.
subjects: photo ID for all voters including mail ballots
